lede: The biggest thing on the calendar this week is a pair of back-to-back hearings on the Carhenge redevelopment at 700 W. Pacific — a special HARC session reviewing preliminary architecture for the proposed multi-building project, followed immediately by a Town Council appeal of the lot subdivision that has to get settled before any of it can move forward. The Gondola Leadership Committee also faces a genuine fork in the road on September 28th, weighing federal funding against local financing for project delivery. Woven into the week are the Original Thinkers festival and a watershed restoration talk at the Sherbino.

notable.stake: Council chooses between federal dollars or local control for gondola delivery.
HARC reviews three separate Preliminary Large-Scale applications for Carhenge redevelopment.
Council decides appeal that controls whether Carhenge lot subdivision stands.
Commissioners discuss proposed Employee Housing Impact Fee for unincorporated county.
Final architecture review for 15 workforce apartments and four new multifamily units.
2027 General Fund and Capital Fund contours take shape before formal adoption.
